g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Kite rim sampled before spar and tail; duplicate junction dots omitted. Drum shell sampled before oval head, removing duplicate contact dots. Tambourine contours and four jingle circles remain separated. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Kite sail, drum shell and tambourine ring are lower grey; contours, spar and tail higher black. Drum head, tambourine centre and jingle interiors remain white unraised. No measured-height or material claim.
